comment: Last month's Servicios payments, the table at the bottom of the Servicios screen. previousMonth: the calendar month before the one `today` falls in, as an inclusive YYYY-MM-DD range (January wraps to the previous December). payments: of `expenses` (already bounded to that month), the ones in category `services` — every one, whether or not its note names a service on the register, because the question is what was paid — ordered by date, then id. totalAudCents sums every row's amountCents; totalUsdCents sums usdCents where present (what the bank charged, verified rows only); unverified counts rows without usdCents, so the USD total can say it is partial.

payments.name: only Servicios, by date then id, verified and not
a Servicios expense naming no service still counts
